command_feedback_proof.pending: The invoked row and shared status region show pending until the route returns.

command_feedback_proof.failure: The server rejection code is preserved in an alert.

binding_proof: Submission hash and Review hash are displayed before Acceptance.
Action parameter hash and latest Approval id are displayed before approval or execution.
Every projected command displays its authoritative resource id when one exists.
projection_repairs: Pending ActionRequest attention and approval use the canonical pending_approval state.

browser_acceptance.journey: Create and confirm a Target through real UI, inspect blocked activation on the empty graph, verify keyboard focus and no overflow, observe native Home attention, and reopen Workbench.

residual_risks: Real Feishu delivery, real GitHub pull request and restart/fault acceptance remain T010 prerequisites.
